label: S5 next implementation specification, not a completed experiment
priority: autonomous walking before all other platform stages

teacher_only.method: contact-aware full-body trajectory optimization through MuJoCo rollouts
teacher_only.variables: bounded joint target rates for all 42 actuators; support legs remain optimizable during swing
teacher_only.initialization: traceable measured or official teacher motion retargeted into current joint limits; previous successful stepping policies are candidate warm starts only
constraints: unchanged joint limits and torque caps
teacher_only.screening: check full-body dynamic feasibility with corrected adhesion before imitation; record every failure and actual control authority

student.architecture: single whole-body 42-output observation-driven ANN with recurrent neural state if needed; all-leg proprioception and contact inputs
student.dataset: complete continuous episodes, fixed task instruction per episode; retain student-visited states for corrective teaching
student.optimizer: correct termination/bootstrapping and analytic full-rollout KL with transactional rollback
student.deployment: no teacher, scheduled leg prompt sequence, external phase, torso feedback controller or trajectory replay; only neural policy through declared incremental actuators

acceptance: original walking gates and physical handoff protocol; independent replay plus synchronous full-body video. Numerical regression, teacher motion and single-leg passes do not count as autonomous walking.
limits: Replacement ANN capability is never connectome capability. No promise of success from a specified finite search. SI calibration NOT_ESTABLISHED.
